evidence.name: Screen field: Padding inside each item
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Padding inside each item" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Padding inside each item
sections.description: The space between each item's edge and its content (title, image, checkbox), set per side — top, end, bottom, start. More padding makes items feel roomy and easier to tap; too little looks cramped. Around 12–16px on all sides reads well on mobile, and the setting applies to every item.
